description: This Java source file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to enable custom log chaining and allows logs to be directed to multiple targets via the linked list of LogNodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class implementing LogNode that wraps Android's native Log utility. It forwards log messages to the internal LogNode chain and calls Android's Log.println to output logs.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to send log data to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs the log message to Android's native log system and forwards it to the next LogNode if present. Handles null messages and exceptions appropriately.
